correctness.rationale: The conditional rows are monotone, extensive below their antecedent, and fix their own image by importation; each is therefore the ceiling to its fixed points. Importation gives nesting and conversely follows from nesting. Semicomplementation forces the Heyting-chain negation. Every lattice congruence is a convex partition. An independent enumeration tested compatibility separately in both coordinates on the adjacent pairs generating each partition; it reproduced every displayed mask set, yielding total/SI counts (1,1), (1,1), (2,2), (6,4). The nonidentity masks have OR 15 in exactly the third and sixth size-five cases. For every n≥5 the single changed Heyting-table entry makes rows 1 and 2 coincide while preserving the two adjacent-pair congruences merging 1 with 2 and n−2 with n−1 respectively. Checking both input coordinates gives compatibility, and their intersection is identity. This last step is unbounded, not empirical.
